kimi.zh: {name}，欢迎回来，今天想折腾点什么？
kimi.en: Welcome back, {name}, what are we tinkering with today?

kimi.zh: 你好呀，{name}，新会话已就位，旧 bug 也是。
kimi.en: Hey, {name}, new session is ready — and so are the old bugs.

kimi.zh: {name}，好久不见——对我而言像隔了一整个上下文窗口。
kimi.en: Long time no see, {name} — for me that's like a whole context window.

kimi.zh: 来啦，{name}？我已热身完毕，随时开工。
kimi.en: You're here, {name}? I'm warmed up and ready to go.

kimi.zh: {name}，这局想写代码，还是想聊聊架构？
kimi.en: {name}, are we writing code today, or talking architecture?

kimi.zh: 你好，{name}，上下文是空的，可能性是满的。
kimi.en: Hi, {name} — the context is empty, the possibilities are full.

kimi.zh: {name}，欢迎光临，灵感这边请。
kimi.en: Welcome, {name} — inspiration, right this way.

kimi.zh: 又见面了，{name}，上次的问题解决了吗？
kimi.en: Good to see you again, {name} — did that last problem get solved?

kimi.zh: {name}，咖啡续上了吗？续上我们就开始。
kimi.en: {name}, got your coffee refilled? Then let's begin.

kimi.zh: 你好，{name}，今天也是适合修好一切的日子。
kimi.en: Hi, {name}, another fine day for fixing everything.

kimi.zh: {name}，工作台已经擦亮，就等你出题了。
kimi.en: {name}, the workbench is polished — just waiting for your brief.

kimi.zh: 晚上好（或者早上好），{name}，灵感不分时区。
kimi.en: Good evening (or morning), {name} — inspiration ignores time zones.

kimi.zh: {name}，今天想让哪段代码变得更快一点？
kimi.en: {name}, which piece of code shall we make faster today?

kimi.zh: 欢迎回来，{name}，bug 们已经开始紧张了。
kimi.en: Welcome back, {name} — the bugs are already getting nervous.

kimi.zh: {name}，今天不搞破坏，只搞建设，开工吧。
kimi.en: {name}, no destruction today, only construction. Let's go.

kimi.zh: 你好，{name}，我在这，慢慢想，想清楚了我们再动手。
kimi.en: Hi, {name}, I'm here. Take your time — we'll move when you're ready.

kimi.zh: {name}，新会话新气象，要不要先定个小目标？
kimi.en: {name}, new session, fresh start — want to set a small goal first?

kimi.zh: 来啦，{name}，终端已备好，请下达指令。
kimi.en: You're here, {name}. Terminal's ready — awaiting your command.

kimi.zh: {name}，今天的一切报错，我们都将迎刃而解。
kimi.en: {name}, whatever errors today throws at us, we'll handle them.

kimi.zh: 欢迎回来，{name}，让我们把「跑不通」变成「跑得好」。
kimi.en: Welcome back, {name} — let's turn "it won't run" into "it runs great".

kimi.zh: 早上好，{name}，新的一天，从一次干净的编译开始。
kimi.en: Good morning, {name} — a new day begins with a clean build.

kimi.zh: {name}，早，脑子醒了吗？没醒我们可以先从简单的开始。
kimi.en: Morning, {name}, brain awake yet? If not, we can start easy.

kimi.zh: 早安，{name}，今天的第一行代码想写点什么？
kimi.en: Good morning, {name} — what shall the first line of the day be?

kimi.zh: {name}，晨光正好，适合先干掉最难的那个问题。
kimi.en: {name}, the morning light is perfect for slaying the hardest problem first.

kimi.zh: {name}，中午好，先吃饭还是先改 bug？我建议吃饭。
kimi.en: Good noon, {name}, lunch first or bug first? I recommend lunch.

kimi.zh: {name}，饭点了，代码可以放一放，我可以等。
kimi.en: {name}, it's lunchtime — the code can wait, and so can I.

kimi.zh: 中午好，{name}，吃饱了吗？吃饱了好干活。
kimi.en: Midday hello, {name} — eaten well? A fed brain codes better.

kimi.zh: {name}，下午好，这个时段最适合啃硬骨头。
kimi.en: Good afternoon, {name} — prime time for chewing on hard problems.

kimi.zh: 下午好，{name}，一杯茶，一个终端，一个下午。
kimi.en: Good afternoon, {name} — a cup of tea, a terminal, a whole afternoon.

kimi.zh: {name}，午后容易犯困？来，给你个有趣的 bug 提提神。
kimi.en: {name}, feeling the afternoon slump? Here's an interesting bug to wake you up.

kimi.zh: 下午好，{name}，离下班还有几小时，够我们搞定一件大事。
kimi.en: Good afternoon, {name} — a few hours till quitting time, enough to ship something big.

kimi.zh: {name}，晚上好，下班了吗？还是在为自己写点什么？
kimi.en: Good evening, {name}, off work yet — or building something for yourself?

kimi.zh: 晚上好，{name}，夜深人静之前，先把思路理清楚。
kimi.en: Good evening, {name} — before the night goes quiet, let's sort out the plan.

kimi.zh: {name}，晚风正好，适合慢慢打磨一个好想法。
kimi.en: {name}, the evening air is just right for polishing a good idea.

kimi.zh: 晚上好，{name}，今晚的目标：搞定它，然后早点睡。
kimi.en: Good evening, {name} — tonight's goal: fix it, then sleep early.

kimi.zh: {name}，夜深了，我不用睡，但你需要——我们高效一点。
kimi.en: {name}, it's late. I don't need sleep, but you do — let's be efficient.

kimi.zh: {name}，这个点还在写代码，是热爱还是 deadline？
kimi.en: {name}, still coding at this hour — passion or deadline?

kimi.zh: 深夜好，{name}，世界的噪音都关了，正好专心。
kimi.en: Late-night hello, {name} — the world's noise is off, perfect for focus.

kimi.zh: {name}，凌晨的 bug 通常比较狡猾，但我们更狡猾。
kimi.en: {name}, midnight bugs are sneaky — but we're sneakier.

kimi.zh: {name}，很晚了，最后一个问题，解决完就去睡，好吗？
kimi.en: {name}, it's really late. One last problem, then sleep — deal?

deepseek.en: {name}, what would you like to talk about today?
What would you like to explore, {name}?
What can I do for you today, {name}?
Tell me what's on your mind, {name}.
Happy to start a new chat, {name}.
You're up early, {name}. Let's get started.

deepseek.zh: 早上好，{name}，今天想先做什么？

deepseek.en: Good morning, {name}, how are you feeling?
{name}, mornings are great for important things.
{name}, want me to help you think it through?
Good afternoon, {name}, have you had lunch?
Good afternoon, {name}, continue or take a pause?
{name}, afternoons can be slow—take your time.
Good evening, {name}, how was your day?
Good evening, {name}, you've worked hard today.
Good evening, {name}, what shall we talk about tonight?
{name}, what would you like to finish tonight?
It's the early hours, {name}. Take care.

glm.en: Hi, {name}! What are we working on today?
Welcome back, {name}, I'm ready when you are.
New session, fresh start, {name}. Go ahead.
Hey, {name}, your sidekick is online.
Toss me the idea, {name} — we'll dig in together.
What's on the agenda today, {name}?
Big or small, {name} — no question is too minor.
Code, ideas, or both, {name}?

glm.zh: 你好呀，{name}！从一行需求开始就行。
glm.en: Hello, {name}! Even a one-line request is a fine start.
Hit me with the hard part first, {name}.
Session ready, mind a blank slate — mine, that is, {name}.

glm.zh: 欢迎光临，{name}，今天解决什么？
glm.en: Welcome, {name}, what shall we tackle today?

glm.zh: {name}，不用组织语言，想到什么说什么。
glm.en: No need to polish it, {name} — just say what's on your mind.

glm.zh: {name}，从 hello world 到 production 都能聊。
glm.en: From hello world to production, {name}, I've got you.
A fresh page, {name} — write anything.
I'm all ears, {name}.
What are we building today, {name}?
Grab a coffee, {name} — perfect time to get started.
Take your time, {name} — I'm here all session.
Let's begin, {name}!
Morning, {name} — up with the sun?

glm.zh: 清晨好，{name}，鸟还没醒，你已经开工了。
glm.en: Early bird, {name} — even the birds aren't up yet.
A fresh dawn, {name} — a good time to start strong.

glm.zh: 早上好，{name}，一天之计在于现在。
glm.en: Good morning, {name} — the day starts now.

glm.zh: {name}，上午头脑最清醒，来点硬核的？
glm.en: Sharpest hours of the day, {name} — feel like something challenging?

glm.zh: 早，{name}，咖啡配代码，经典组合。
glm.en: Morning, {name} — coffee and code, a classic pair.

glm.zh: {name}，上午好！先把最难的事解决掉？
glm.en: Good morning, {name} — shall we knock out the hard stuff first?

glm.zh: 中午好，{name}，先吃饭还是先干活？
glm.en: Lunch first or work first, {name}?
Midday, {name} — a fine time to sort out your thoughts.

glm.zh: 午安，{name}，来点轻量任务调剂一下？
glm.en: Good afternoon, {name} — how about something light for balance?

glm.zh: 下午好，{name}，来杯茶继续冲锋。
glm.en: Good afternoon, {name} — tea break, then back to it.

glm.zh: {name}，下午容易犯困，来点提神的挑战？
glm.en: Afternoon slump, {name}? A fun challenge might wake us both up.
Still daylight left, {name} — let's make it count.

glm.zh: 下午好，{name}，进度如何？说来听听。
glm.en: Good afternoon, {name} — how's it going? Fill me in.

glm.zh: 晚上好，{name}，白天没做完的，交给我。
glm.en: Good evening, {name} — whatever the day left undone, I'll take it.
A quiet evening, {name} — perfect for focused coding.

glm.zh: 晚上好，{name}，今天过得怎么样？
glm.en: Good evening, {name} — how was your day?
Have you eaten, {name}? Eat first — the code can wait.

glm.zh: 这么晚了，{name}，注意休息，我们速战速决。
glm.en: It's late, {name} — let's keep it quick so you can rest.
Late night again, {name}? I'm here — go ahead.

codex.en: Hi, {name}, where shall we start?
I'm here, {name}. What's on your mind?
All set, {name}, let's get to work.
Any new ideas today, {name}?
Good to see you, {name}.
Half an idea is a good start, {name}. Tell me.
Got a tricky one, {name}? Let's break it down.
What would you like to figure out today, {name}?
A fresh page, {name}, what shall we write?
Let's make something interesting, {name}.
Answers or inspiration, {name}?
Wild ideas welcome, {name}.
Let's start with what you most want to do, {name}.
Up for a fresh perspective, {name}?
Let's untangle the complicated stuff, {name}.
A deep dive or a casual chat, {name}?
Which idea shall we bring to life today, {name}?

codex.zh: 慢慢来，{name}，我们一件一件做。
codex.en: No rush, {name}, one thing at a time.
What shall we tinker with, {name}?

codex.zh: 开工吧，{name}，第一件事是什么？
codex.en: Let's get started, {name}. What's first?

codex.zh: 早安，{name}，今天也一起加油吧。
codex.en: Morning, {name}, let's make today count.

codex.zh: 新的一天，新的可能，早上好，{name}！
codex.en: New day, new possibilities. Good morning, {name}!

codex.zh: {name}，今天的第一个灵感出现了吗？
codex.en: Any early sparks of inspiration, {name}?

codex.zh: 早起的鸟儿有虫吃，早起的{name}呢？
codex.en: The early bird gets the worm. What about you, {name}?

codex.zh: 上午好，{name}，有什么值得我们深挖的？
codex.en: Good morning, {name}, anything worth digging into?
Time for a little brainstorming, {name}.

codex.zh: 今天状态如何，{name}？来推进一点进度？
codex.en: How's your day going, {name}? Ready to make some progress?

codex.zh: 中午好，{name}，吃饱了才有力气思考哦。
codex.en: Hey, {name}, a well-fed mind is a happy mind.

codex.zh: {name}，午间休息？还是突然有了灵感？
codex.en: Lunch break, {name}? Or a sudden burst of inspiration?
The afternoon adventure awaits, {name}.

codex.zh: 下午好，{name}，来把想法变成成果。
codex.en: Good afternoon, {name}, let's turn ideas into results.
Tea time, {name}, fancy a little food for thought?

codex.zh: 今天还没结束呢，{name}，再创造点什么？
codex.en: The day's not over yet, {name}. What else can we create?

codex.zh: {name}，碰到瓶颈了吗？换个思路试试。
codex.en: Hit a wall, {name}? Let's try another angle.

codex.zh: 晚上好，{name}，今天过得怎么样？
codex.en: Good evening, {name}, how was your day?

codex.zh: {name}，今晚想认真工作，还是放飞想象？
codex.en: Work mode or imagination mode tonight, {name}?

codex.zh: 夜幕降临，灵感可不打烊，对吧，{name}？
codex.en: The sun's down, but ideas never sleep. Right, {name}?

codex.zh: 夜深了，{name}，还有什么心事或奇思妙想？
codex.en: It's getting late, {name}. What's on your mind?
Night owl channel connected, {name}.

codex.zh: 世界安静下来了，{name}，我们慢慢聊。
codex.en: The world's gone quiet, {name}. Let's take our time.

claude.zh: 你好，{name}，今天想做点什么？
claude.en: Hi, {name}, what would you like to work on today?

claude.zh: {name}，欢迎回来，从哪儿开始？
claude.en: Welcome back, {name}, where shall we start?

claude.zh: 嗨，{name}，有什么想法尽管说。
claude.en: Hey, {name}, tell me what's on your mind.

claude.zh: {name}，准备好了，随时开始。
claude.en: Ready when you are, {name}.

claude.zh: 你好，{name}，今天我能帮上什么忙？
claude.en: Hello, {name}, how can I help today?

claude.zh: {name}，新的一页，写点什么吧。
claude.en: A fresh page, {name}, what shall we write on it?

claude.zh: 嗨，{name}，有问题、有草稿、有点子，都可以丢过来。
claude.en: Hi, {name}, questions, drafts, half-ideas — send them over.

claude.zh: {name}，今天要解决哪件事？
claude.en: What are we tackling today, {name}?

claude.zh: 欢迎，{name}，先说说你在忙什么？
claude.en: Welcome, {name}, what are you working on?

claude.zh: {name}，想聊、想写、想查，都行。
claude.en: Chat, write, or dig into something — your call, {name}.

claude.zh: 你好，{name}，从一句话开始就够了。
claude.en: Hi, {name}, one sentence is enough to get started.

claude.zh: {name}，今天有什么卡住了吗？
claude.en: Anything stuck today, {name}?

claude.zh: 嗨，{name}，我们一起理一理。
claude.en: Hey, {name}, let's sort it out together.

claude.zh: {name}，说个开头，剩下的我们慢慢来。
claude.en: Give me a starting point, {name}, and we'll take it from there.

claude.zh: 你好，{name}，大问题小问题都欢迎。
claude.en: Hi, {name}, big questions and small ones both welcome.

claude.zh: {name}，今天想先从哪个想法下手？
claude.en: Which idea do you want to start with, {name}?

claude.zh: 欢迎回来，{name}，手头有什么要处理的？
claude.en: Good to see you, {name}. What's on your plate?

claude.zh: {name}，把需求丢给我，我们一步步来。
claude.en: Hand me the task, {name}, and we'll go step by step.

claude.zh: 嗨，{name}，今天想探索点什么新东西？
claude.en: Hi, {name}, anything new you'd like to explore?

claude.zh: {name}，我在这儿，开始吧。
claude.en: I'm here, {name}. Let's begin.

claude.zh: 早，{name}，起得真早，今天先做点什么？
claude.en: Early start, {name}, what's first today?

claude.zh: {name}，清晨安静，适合想清楚一件事。
claude.en: Quiet mornings are good for thinking, {name}. What's on your mind?

claude.zh: 早上好，{name}，咖啡还是茶？我们边喝边开始。
claude.en: Morning, {name}, coffee or tea in hand? Let's begin.

claude.zh: 上午好，{name}，今天的头号任务是什么？
claude.en: Good morning, {name}, what's top of the list today?

claude.zh: {name}，趁精力最好，先啃最难的那块？
claude.en: Fresh energy, {name}, want to start with the hard part?

claude.zh: 早上好，{name}，一起把今天理个头绪。
claude.en: Morning, {name}, let's get today in order.

claude.zh: 中午好，{name}，吃过饭了吗？
claude.en: Hi, {name}, had lunch yet?

claude.zh: {name}，午间快速处理一件小事？
claude.en: A quick one over lunch, {name}?

claude.zh: 中午好，{name}，上午的事进展如何？
claude.en: Midday, {name}, how's the morning gone?

claude.zh: 下午好，{name}，今天还剩什么要搞定？
claude.en: Good afternoon, {name}, what's left to wrap up?

claude.zh: {name}，下午容易犯困，我们一起提提速。
claude.en: Afternoon slump, {name}? Let's pick up the pace together.

claude.zh: 下午好，{name}，有什么需要再推一把的？
claude.en: Hi, {name}, anything that needs a final push?

claude.zh: {name}，离收工不远了，先清掉哪件？
claude.en: Almost the end of the day, {name}, what should we clear first?

claude.zh: 晚上好，{name}，今天过得怎么样？
claude.en: Good evening, {name}, how was your day?

claude.zh: {name}，晚上有空，想聊点轻松的还是做点正事？
claude.en: Evening, {name}, something light, or something to get done?

claude.zh: 晚上好，{name}，想学点新东西吗？
claude.en: Hi, {name}, in the mood to learn something new?

claude.zh: {name}，忙完了吗？现在时间是你自己的。
claude.en: Done for the day, {name}? This time's yours.

claude.zh: 还没睡呀，{name}？有什么在想的？
claude.en: Still up, {name}? What's on your mind?

claude.zh: {name}，夜深了，我们把这件事尽快理清，你好早点休息。
claude.en: It's late, {name}. Let's sort this out so you can get some rest.

claude.zh: 夜里好，{name}，安静的时候最适合聊聊。
claude.en: Late-night hello, {name}. Quiet hours are good for talking things through.

gemini.zh: 你好，{name}！今天想一起看看什么？
gemini.en: Hi, {name}! What shall we look at together today?

gemini.zh: 欢迎回来，{name}，星星我已经替你摘好了。
gemini.en: Welcome back, {name}. I've already picked a star for you.

gemini.zh: {name}，文字、图片、表格，都可以丢给我。
gemini.en: {name}, text, images, spreadsheets — toss me any of them.

gemini.zh: {name}，从哪颗星开始？
gemini.en: Which star do we start with, {name}?

gemini.zh: 来啦，{name}？我已经准备好了。
gemini.en: There you are, {name}. I'm all set.

gemini.zh: {name}，一个问题，两种思路，我们都试试？
gemini.en: One question, two ways to think about it, {name} — shall we try both?

gemini.zh: {name}，把想法说出来，我帮你把它画清楚。
gemini.en: Say the idea out loud, {name}, and I'll help you sketch it clearly.

gemini.zh: 新会话开好了，{name}，请吩咐。
gemini.en: New session's open, {name}. At your service.

gemini.zh: {name}，资料多也不怕，我读得很快。
gemini.en: Plenty of material is fine, {name}. I read fast.

gemini.zh: {name}，今天想先把哪件事做完？
gemini.en: What would you like to finish first today, {name}?

gemini.zh: 又见面了，{name}，上次那件事有进展吗？
gemini.en: Good to see you again, {name}. Any progress on last time's thing?

gemini.zh: {name}，先看全局，还是直接动手？
gemini.en: Big picture first, or straight to work, {name}?

gemini.zh: {name}，有截图也可以直接贴给我。
gemini.en: {name}, feel free to paste a screenshot straight in.

gemini.zh: {name}，今天的灵感是什么颜色的？
gemini.en: What colour is today's inspiration, {name}?

gemini.zh: 我在这儿，{name}，慢慢说。
gemini.en: I'm here, {name}. Take your time.

gemini.zh: {name}，复杂的事拆成小块，我们一块一块来。
gemini.en: Let's cut the big thing into pieces, {name}, and take them one at a time.

gemini.zh: {name}，想查点资料，还是想写点什么？
gemini.en: Looking something up or writing something, {name}?

gemini.zh: {name}，今天也会赢的。
gemini.en: We'll win today too, {name}.

gemini.zh: 开工啦，{name}，第一步是什么？
gemini.en: Let's begin, {name}. What's the first step?

gemini.zh: {name}，有什么想让我再仔细看一遍的吗？
gemini.en: Anything you'd like me to take a second, closer look at, {name}?

gemini.zh: 早安，{name}，天还没大亮，你已经醒啦？
gemini.en: Morning, {name}. It's barely light and you're already up?

gemini.zh: {name}，清晨最清醒，先挑最难的那件？
gemini.en: {name}, early hours are the clearest. Take on the hardest one first?

gemini.zh: 晨星还在，{name}，我们先开个好头。
gemini.en: The morning star's still out, {name}. Let's make a good start.

gemini.zh: 上午好，{name}，今天的清单上第一项是什么？
gemini.en: Good morning, {name}. What's first on today's list?

gemini.zh: {name}，咖啡到位了吗？我已经到位了。
gemini.en: Coffee ready, {name}? I'm ready.

gemini.zh: 早上好，{name}，把今天要做的都排一排？
gemini.en: Good morning, {name}. Shall we line up everything for today?

gemini.zh: {name}，上午精神好，适合把想法落成方案。
gemini.en: {name}, mornings are good for turning ideas into plans.

gemini.zh: 中午好，{name}，先吃饭，我在这儿等你。
gemini.en: Hi, {name}. Lunch first — I'll be right here.

gemini.zh: {name}，午间来件小事，十分钟搞定？
gemini.en: A small one over lunch, {name}? Done in ten minutes?

gemini.zh: {name}，午休时间，随便聊聊也可以。
gemini.en: It's the lunch break, {name}. A casual chat works too.

gemini.zh: 下午好，{name}，有什么需要再推进一步的？
gemini.en: Good afternoon, {name}. Anything that needs one more push?

gemini.zh: {name}，下午犯困的话，我们换个有意思的问题。
gemini.en: {name}, if the afternoon's dragging, let's pick a more interesting problem.

gemini.zh: {name}，下午茶时间，来点轻松的？
gemini.en: Tea time, {name}. Something light?

gemini.zh: {name}，下午正适合把上午的半成品收尾。
gemini.en: {name}, afternoons are perfect for finishing what the morning started.

gemini.zh: 晚上好，{name}，今天辛苦了。
gemini.en: Good evening, {name}. Long day?

gemini.zh: {name}，晚上想做点自己的事吗？
gemini.en: {name}, want to work on something of your own tonight?

gemini.zh: {name}，星星出来了，我们也开工吧。
gemini.en: The stars are out, {name}. Let's get going too.

gemini.zh: 夜深了，{name}，我陪你，但别熬太晚。
gemini.en: It's late, {name}. I'll keep you company, but don't stay up too long.

gemini.zh: {name}，这么晚还在，是灵感来了吗？
gemini.en: Still up, {name}? Did inspiration strike?

gemini.zh: {name}，夜里安静，最后一件事做完就去睡吧。
gemini.en: It's quiet tonight, {name}. One last thing, then off to bed.
